import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router component that splits claims into three ports based on ordered rules.
    Rules are evaluated in order; a row matches the FIRST matching rule only.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port (standard).
    """
    claims = inputs['claims'].copy()
    
    # Initialize output dataframes
    fast_track = []
    high_value = []
    manual_review = []
    standard = []
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = set()
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1 → fast_track
    mask1 = (claims['amount'] <= 500) & (claims['photos_attached'] == 1)
    fast_track_indices = claims[mask1].index.tolist()
    fast_track = claims.loc[fast_track_indices].copy()
    matched.update(fast_track_indices)
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000 → high_value (only for unmatched rows)
    remaining_indices = [i for i in claims.index if i not in matched]
    remaining = claims.loc[remaining_indices]
    mask2 = remaining['amount'] > 10000
    high_value_indices = remaining[mask2].index.tolist()
    high_value = remaining.loc[high_value_indices].copy()
    matched.update(high_value_indices)
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500 → manual_review (only for unmatched rows)
    remaining_indices = [i for i in claims.index if i not in matched]
    remaining = claims.loc[remaining_indices]
    mask3 = (remaining['photos_attached'] == 0) | (remaining['amount'] > 500)
    manual_review_indices = remaining[mask3].index.tolist()
    manual_review = remaining.loc[manual_review_indices].copy()
    matched.update(manual_review_indices)
    
    # Default port: standard (unmatched rows)
    remaining_indices = [i for i in claims.index if i not in matched]
    standard = claims.loc[remaining_indices].copy()
    
    # Select only the specified columns
    columns = ['claim_id', 'amount', 'photos_attached']
    
    fast_track = fast_track[columns] if len(fast_track) > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=columns)
    high_value = high_value[columns] if len(high_value) > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=columns)
    manual_review = manual_review[columns] if len(manual_review) > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=columns)
    
    # Ensure dtypes are preserved
    for col in columns:
        if col in claims.columns:
            if len(fast_track) > 0:
                fast_track[col] = fast_track[col].astype(claims[col].dtype)
            if len(high_value) > 0:
                high_value[col] = high_value[col].astype(claims[col].dtype)
            if len(manual_review) > 0:
                manual_review[col] = manual_review[col].astype(claims[col].dtype)
    
    return {
        'claims_fast_track': fast_track.reset_index(drop=True),
        'claims_high_value': high_value.reset_index(drop=True),
        'claims_manual_review': manual_review.reset_index(drop=True)
    }
